title: A Wonderful and Memorable Way to Experience Barcelona
text:
We had a truly wonderful experience exploring Barcelona with the team from Oh My Guide Barcelona. From the very beginning, everything felt warm, welcoming, and thoughtfully organized.

Christina guided us through the old city and the local markets, and she immediately made us feel comfortable. She is incredibly kind and engaging, and exactly the kind of guide you hope to have when discovering a new city. title: Wonderful family tours
text: We did two trips with OHMyGuide in Barcelona.  One was a sweet tour and one was a Guadi tour.  We are a family of 12 with Four children (ages 3-14).  Both guides (Delores and Oliver) were fantastic.  They were terrific with kids and easily accommodated our needs, for example, making sure we had time to get food for the kids.  Cristina worked with us to find the best trips for our family.  Thanks to everyone for making our Barcelona trip do enjoyable snd meaningful.
author: Sue G

title: Interesting city and delicious food
text: The sweets tour is a wonderful way to see the architecture of city while also learning about the culture and enjoying sweet treats! We enjoyed turron (a nougaty dessert usually eaten at Christmas), cream, hard candies, and so many other sweets we never would have tried otherwise. The neighborhood was equally interesting. Cristina is knowledgable about the city, and told us about the history and recommending other places and experiences that I never would have found otherwise. We've also been on her Sitges tour and Barcelona crimes tour and would recommend them all.
author: W1524IVisabelm

title: Interesting and Very childfriendly
text: Excellent tour, we learnt a lot of interesting things about Barcelona "sweet" history. Very childfriendly with all the sweet interactive experiences
author: F8864MLcristinad

title: Good tour
text: A very good experience that makes you discover the sweetest and most historic sites in the center of Barcelona. Highly recommended for both the flavors you discover and Cristina's explanations.
author: MaiArq

title: Excellent tour
text: An excellent tour, you learn many curiosities about the city, visit historic and modern shops, the tastings during the tour are very good. A highly recommended route, Cristina is a super professional guide that makes it very enjoyable to discover the city with her!
